Name: Ahab, Son of Kolaiah
Summary: Ahab, son of Kolaiah, was one of the false prophets among the Babylonian exiles whom Jeremiah denounced; he prophesied lies in God's name, and Jeremiah foretold that Nebuchadnezzar would roast him and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah in the fire.
KeyStory: Jeremiah named Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah as men who prophesied lies, and said the king of Babylon would slay them before the exiles' eyes.
RelatedPeople: Zedekiah, Son of Maaseiah; Jeremiah; King Nebuchadnezzar
LifeLesson: Using God's name to bless what God has not blessed ends in exposure.
